proposal.summary: The armv8_dec_aes_gcm_full() API of Arm AArch64cryptolib before 86065c6 fails to verify the authentication tag of AES-GCM protected data, leading to a man-in-the-middle attack due to an improperly initialized variable.
proposal.cwe_quote: This occurs because of an improperly initialized variable.
proposal.recommended_next_step: Investigate and patch the armv8_dec_aes_gcm_full() API to ensure proper initialization of variables.

evidence_quotes.claim: The vulnerability is due to an improperly initialized variable.
evidence_quotes.quote: This occurs because of an improperly initialized variable.

evidence_quotes.claim: The vulnerability leads to a man-in-the-middle attack.
